{"metadata":{"description":"Bottom terminal panel plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH Web GUI)","id":"gh:1333995408","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-plugin-terminal","slug":"siberiah2o/dsh-plugin-terminal","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","plugin","terminal"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Bottom terminal panel plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH Web GUI)"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-plugin-terminal"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Bottom terminal panel for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI — an interactive multi-tab shell pinned"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" to the bottom of the page (ConPTY on Windows, openpty on Linux/macOS)."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"中文 · MIT"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> Note: this is a DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin — do **not** use plain `npm i dsh-plugin-terminal`; "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"it must be installed through `dsh plugin` to activate."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Collapsed | Expanded | Multi-tab |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- Bottom panel pinned to the viewport, aligned with the conversation column; the input box always st"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ays above the terminal
- Configurable shortcut toggles (default `Ctrl+``, e.g. `Ctrl+J`); drag the t"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"op grip to resize (120px–78% viewport, remembered)
- Multi-tab: `+` new, ✕ close, ⟳ restart; process"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"es keep running on tab switch; live sessions restore after refresh or workspace switch
- Every termi"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"nal remembers its working directory: new tabs start in the current DSH workspace; after a `dsh web` "},{"id":"p11s6","text":"restart, ⟳ brings the process back in its original directory instead of the server launch directory
"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"- **Terminals survive dsh web restarts**: session metadata + scrollback are persisted live to `$DSH_"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"HOME/plugin-data/terminal/`; after a restart they come back as "exited" history tabs (full screen re"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"play, one-click restart of the process); tabs you closed stay closed
- xterm.js 6: colors, blinking "},{"id":"p11s10","text":"cursor, alternate screen, Unicode v11 (CJK width tables), 10000-line scrollback
- WebSocket duplex c"},{"id":"p11s11","text":"hannel to the PTY; dark terminal surface in both light and dark themes
- Copy/paste: select with the"},{"id":"p11s12","text":" mouse and release to copy, right-click to paste; `Ctrl+V` pastes, `Ctrl+Shift+C` / `Ctrl+Shift+V` c"},{"id":"p11s13","text":"opy/paste when the clipboard API is available
- ⚠️ When the GUI is opened over **remote http** (not "},{"id":"p11s14","text":"https / not localhost) browsers disable `navigator.clipboard` (insecure context) - the plugin falls "},{"id":"p11s15","text":"back to `execCommand` copy and lets the browser's native context-menu Paste through, so both still w"},{"id":"p11s16","text":"k to `execCommand` copy and lets the browser's native context-menu Paste through, so both still work"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Plugin behavior lives in the DSH settings document (`$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`, section `terminal`), "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"editable from the GUI at **Settings → Plugins**. Changes apply to sessions created afterwards — no r"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"estart needed; tabs that already exist keep the command they started with."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Field | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| `toggleShortcut` | `ctrl+`` | Keyboard shortcut toggling the bottom panel. Format: `[ctrl|shift|al"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"t|meta]+[...]+key`, e.g. `ctrl+j`, `ctrl+shift+f1`. The key can be a letter, digit, F1–F12, or a nam"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"e (
[代码示例省略，未执行]
yaml
terminal:
toggleShortcut: ctrl+j
shellCommand: cmd.exe /k "C:\cmder\vendor\ini"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"略，未执行]
yaml
terminal:
toggleShortcut: ctrl+j
shellCommand: cmd.exe /k "C:\cmder\vendor\init.bat"
```"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Notes:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- `shellCommand` is used verbatim (no flags are injected): the command line is split on spaces with "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"double quotes honored, so quoted paths work.
- If the shortcut is a key the terminal also consumes ("},{"id":"p17s3","text":"Ctrl+J is the shell's line feed), a press while a terminal pane has focus goes to the shell instead "},{"id":"p17s4","text":"of toggling the panel.
- Operator override: the environment variables `DSH_PLUGIN_TERMINAL_TOGGLE_SH"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"ORTCUT` and `DSH_PLUGIN_TERMINAL_SHELL_COMMAND` take precedence over the settings document (and are "},{"id":"p17s6","text":"the only way to configure headless compositions without the settings service)."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Running codex / claude code in the panel"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"These AI coding CLIs are full-screen TUIs (ANSI escapes + alternate screen + truecolor) and demand a"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" lot from the terminal link. The plugin is tuned for them:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- Child env gets TERM=xterm-256color and COLORTERM=truecolor (when unset), plus LANG/LC_ALL=en_US.UT"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"F-8 and PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 on non-Windows, preventing 256-color fallback and CJK mojibake
- xter"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"m.js 6 answers OSC 10/11/12 queries out of the box (Codex theme detection via background-color query"},{"id":"p20s4","text":" just works)
- unicodeVersion "11" keeps mixed CN/EN output aligned; drawBoldTextInBrightColors: fal"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"se keeps true colors on bold text; CJK fallbacks in the font stack; 10000-line scrollback (500k-char"},{"id":"p20s6","text":" server ring buffer)"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"If rendering still misbehaves:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Claude Code**: run /tui fullscreen in the session (or CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1 claude) to switch"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" to the flicker-free fullscreen renderer; /tui default reverts
- **Inside tmux**: make sure TERM=tmu"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"x-256color and tmux >= 3.4, add `set -ga terminal-overrides ',xterm-256color:RGB'` if needed
- **Win"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"dows mojibake**: use Windows Terminal, chcp 65001, enable the "Beta: Use Unicode UTF-8" system optio"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"n; fall back to WSL if it persists
- **Update the CLI**: most rendering bugs are regressions already"},{"id":"p22s6","text":" fixed in newer versions"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
